banners.name: Ichigo Kurosaki・Bankai Unleashed!
banners.note: Launch banner. The first-ever limited SSR in Bleach Soul Resonance — Full Assault type. Weapon: "Power of Hollowfication."

banners.name: Toshiro Hitsugaya & Momo Hinamori・Winter Dual Release!
banners.note: Dual limited banner. Both SSR. Weapons: "Crimson Ice Dragon" (Hitsugaya) and "Blazing Blossoms" (Hinamori).

banners.name: Sosuke Aizen・The Transcendent Villain
banners.note: Banner extended by 7 days — the announcement that all future limited banners would run 21 days. Weapon: "Before We Knew It."

banners.name: Gin Ichimaru・The Silver Flash
banners.note: First 21-day banner following Aizen's extension. Rangiku Matsumoto featured as rate-up SR+. Weapon: "The Fastest Zanpakuto."

banners.name: Kenpachi・Frenzied Beast
banners.note: Grimmjow's replacement, second limited Slash SSR with ailment. Ailment Mastery was introduced with this banner. All previous limited SSR (including Gin) reran towards the end of Kenpachi's banner.

banners.name: Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck・Former Espada Tres
banners.note: First limited Thrust tactic SSR. Released during Chinese New Year.

banners.name: Kurotsuchi Mayuri・Head of Research Institute
banners.note: First limited SSR support since launch, Kisuke's first replacement.

banners.name: Soi Fon・Flash Assault
banners.note: First limited Strike-type SSR since launch. A free copy of Yoruichi Shihoin was distributed to all players upon banner start.

banners.name: Szayelaporro Granz・The Eighth Espada
banners.note: Spirit-type support SSR. Espada No. 8 — the scientist of Hueco Mundo. Aizen reran alongside Szayelaporro's release. A free copy of SR+ Grimmjow was distributed to all players.

banners.name: Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez・Pantera Resurge!
banners.note: Half-anniversary celebration banner. Grimmjow debuts alongside his Pantera release form. Soi Fon limited rerun ran concurrently.

banners.name: Ulquiorra Shifar (Base) SR+ Free Unit
banners.note: Base form Ulquiorra, and will be free via mail on the 5th of June, 2026 (UTC).

banners.name: Ichigo Kurosaki・Inner Hollow Releases!
banners.note: First limited Slash Tactic SSR. White debuts in his Shikai as well as Bankai forms.

banners.name: Ulquiorra Shifar (Resurrección) SSR Rate-Up
banners.note: Ulquiorra Shifar set to compete against Toshiro as a Spirit Full Assault with his dual forms; Murciélago and Segunda Etapa.

banners.name: Ichigo Kurosaki (True Shikai) SSR Rate-Up
banners.note: Ichigo Kurosaki (True Shikai) is based on the TYBW arc. He is a COLLAB unit, which means there likely won't be a second go at him. While we don't know the typing nor role, we do suspect he'll be coming July 15th along with Uryu Ishida (Vollständig), and will be a thrust DPS. This banner will use currently available limited tickets for summons, there will not be a new type added.

banners.name: Uryu Ishida (Vollständig) SSR Rate-Up
banners.note: Uryu Ishida (Vollständig) is based on the TYBW arc. He is a COLLAB unit, which means there likely won't be a second go at him. While we don't know the typing nor role, we do suspect he'll be coming in August after Ichigo Kurosaki (True Shikai), and was rumored to be thrust. This banner will use currently available limited tickets for summons, there will not be a new type added.

banners.name: Bambietta Basterbine (Vollständig) SSR Rate-Up
banners.note: Although not confirmed, highly suspected unit to be with Uryu Ishida (Vollständig) and Ichigo Kurosaki (True Shikai). This banner will use currently available limited tickets for summons, there will not be a new type added.

banners.name: Inoue Orihime (TBD) SSR Rate-Up
banners.note: Although not confirmed, highly suspected unit to be with Uryu Ishida (Vollständig) and Ichigo Kurosaki (True Shikai). This banner will use currently available limited tickets for summons, there will not be a new type added.
